plan.title: Add secondary action support to VSCode TreeView
plan.overview: Display all available actions from task-actions.computer.ts as ActionItems in the TreeView, using array position to determine primary vs secondary styling. Primary actions (index 0) keep the existing green play icon; secondary actions (index > 0) use an orange reply icon for visual distinction. This mirrors the CodeLens behavior which already shows all actions.

approach.rationale:
The task-actions.computer.ts already returns multiple actions for statuses like qa (Approve/Rework), pr (Merge/Rework), and in-progress (Continue/Save WIP). The issue is purely in the view layer: extension.ts:149-152 reduces the array to a single action via getNextAction(), and tasks-view.capability.ts:310-321 only creates one ActionItem.
Following the existing patterns: - ThemeIcon with ThemeColor at tasks-view.capability.ts:185 for primary actions - Factory DI pattern at extension.ts:155-163 for injecting dependencies - Capability-Computer separation: no changes to computers needed
The fix involves: 1. Rename getNextAction to getAllActions in extension.ts and return full array 2. Update TasksViewCapabilityDeps interface to expect TaskAction[] 3. Store all actions in TaskItem constructor (not just nextAction) 4. Generate multiple ActionItems in getChildrenForTask() 5. Pass isPrimary flag to ActionItem for icon selection
